title: Training, resume and the development pipeline (NF-1T)
note: NX1-NX7: a non-finite step that does not stop the run, a resume from the wrong step, a data order not tied to its epoch, Adam without bias correction, accumulated gradients not averaged, an exact resume with no parent, statistics never put in the checkpoint.

mutations.name: NX1_non_finite_step_continues
mutations.find: if not math.isfinite(loss) or not rf:

mutations.name: NX2_resume_from_any_step
mutations.rationale: a resume that skips or repeats steps

mutations.name: NX4_adam_without_bias_correction
mutations.rationale: the first step ten times too small

mutations.name: NX5_accumulation_not_averaged
mutations.find: lambda acc, x: acc + x.astype(jnp.float32) / n_micro, g, gi)
mutations.replace: lambda acc, x: acc + x.astype(jnp.float32), g, gi)

mutations.name: NX6_exact_resume_without_parent
mutations.rationale: an exact resume that names no run it continues

mutations.name: NX7_resume_parent_checkpoint_dropped
mutations.rationale: a resumed run that names no checkpoint
